yt_title: Day 6 of 10 — The Market | Anaya's Ten Days EP05
short:
Six days left.

Papa's favourite lunch needs seven things.
She bargained for the first time in her life, and badly.

Six things in the bag.
One thing missing — the one the dish can't be made without.
cta:
So she looked out at the fields 🧡
EP6 tomorrow — the farmer ✦
